map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Franklin, Hamilton and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-09 03:01): early in person 4,079 (state 4,012). Clermont (as of 2026-10-09 13:23): mail returned 54 (state 49); early in person 2,418 (state 1,960). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-08 17:05): early in person 4,685 (state 4,644). Franklin (as of 2026-10-09 00:12): mail returned 175 (state 165); early in person 8,854 (state 8,634); ballots sent 71,672 (state 70,326). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-08 18:00): early in person 6,875 (state 6,694). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-09 11:09): mail returned 100 (state 78).
